technique_name: How did World War I impact the course of history?
description: World War I had far-reaching consequences that shaped the course of history. The war redefined the geopolitical landscape of Europe and the world, leading to the dissolution of empires and the emergence of new states. The global economy was heavily disrupted, resulting in higher taxes and inflation, as well as a deep social and political mistrust.
